name: portward
description: Choose what Claude sees from your own database: local, read-only, every pull recorded.
long_description: Portward connects Claude to your own data: SQLite, CSV and Excel files, and Postgres and MySQL databases. It only runs read-only queries, shows you the rows first in a results panel, and Claude gets only the rows you put in the chat. Database passwords stay in your computer's keychain, and a history of every pull stays on your machine. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
